name: io.github.k-luecke/paxiom-receipts
title: Paxiom Receipts MCP
description: Verify and explain Ed25519 proof-bound receipts (paxiom.receipt.v0) for x402 APIs, and discover live Base USDC settlement & preflight endpoints.

tools.name: verify_receipt
tools.description: Verify a paxiom.receipt.v0 cryptographic receipt (schema, Ed25519 signature, output SHA-256 JCS binding, expiry, and honest settlement/proof trust state). Deterministic and free; automatically trusts the host Paxiom counter-attestation public key when trustedPaxiomPublicKeys is omitted.

tools.name: explain_receipt
tools.description: Verify a paxiom.receipt.v0 receipt and return a concise human/agent-readable trust-state breakdown and next-action guidance.

tools.name: get_x402_verifier_info
tools.description: Return Paxiom Receipt Verifier service metadata, published Ed25519 counter-attestation public keys, and x402 Base USDC payment terms for live on-chain settlement verification ($0.002 USDC) and pre-payment seller preflight ($0.01 USDC).
